title: Customer Operations, VIP Escalation & Knowledge Quality Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Customer Operations, VIP Escalation & Knowledge Quality organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

sheet_map.description: Optional mapping from canonical table key (e.g. invoices) to customer worksheet tab name.

column_map.description: Optional mapping from customer column header or connector JSON field name to canonical engine field name.

war_room_score_threshold.description: Composite score threshold for executive war-room activation.

vip_arr_threshold_usd.description: ARR floor classifying a customer as VIP strategic tier.

detractor_csat_max.description: Maximum CSAT rating (1-5) treated as detractor.

detractor_nps_max.description: Maximum NPS rating (0-10) treated as detractor.

max_resolution_hops.description: Maximum decision tree hops before usability warning.
